skills.detail:
Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement while the skill button is held down.
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage.
Also, deals a mid-range area attack with a chance to set enemies Aflame while the skill button is held down.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active. 
Deals a mid-range area attack with a chance to set enemies Aflame after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
